hook: Nat Friedman works on AI products at Meta, a role his LinkedIn profile dates from July 2025. He was chief executive of GitHub from 2018 to 2021, after Microsoft bought Xamarin, the developer tools company he co-founded. His career began in open source, where he co-founded Ximian and the GNOME Foundation, and between GitHub and Meta he invested in AI companies, partly through NFDG with Daniel Gross.

quick_facts: Works on AI Products at Meta since July 2025, according to his LinkedIn profile
CEO of GitHub from October 2018 to November 2021, then chairman emeritus to November 2022
Corporate vice president for Developer Services at Microsoft from 2016 to 2018
Co-founder and CEO of Xamarin from 2011 to 2016, which his profile says reached 50 million dollars in annual recurring revenue in four and a half years and had 350 people when Microsoft acquired it
Co-founder and chairman of the GNOME Foundation from 2000 to 2003 and co-founder and CEO of Ximian from 1999 to 2003
BS in mathematics and computer science from MIT
